{"id":2042940332,"question_id":4039,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month","timestamp":1782193546,"status":15,"status_display":"Runtime Error","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2042940332/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Compute Decimal Representation","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> decimalRepresentation(int n) {\n        vector<int>ans;\n\n        int placeofdigit = 1;\n        while(n > 0)\n        {\n            int digit = n % 10;\n            if(placeofdigit * digit != 0) ans.push_back(placeofdigit * digit);\n            placeofdigit *= 10;\n            n /= 10;\n        }\n        reverse(begin(ans) , end(ans));\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"compute-decimal-representation","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2212}
